result.instructions: Tools for BoldTrail kvCORE, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the contact with the email address jane@example.com and show her hashtags."; "List the contacts assigned to agent 12432 who registered after 1 January 2026."; "Add a new lead named John Lead for agent 12432 and keep it private to that agent.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes BoldTrail kvCORE data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run boldtrail_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run boldtrail_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run boldtrail_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. boldtrail_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: boldtrail_list_contacts
tools.title: List or search contacts
tools.description: List or search contacts (leads) in BoldTrail kvCORE. Filter by exact email, hashtags, assigned agent id, or registration time (Unix timestamps). Paged: page starts at 1, limit 1-500 (default 100). Endpoint: GET /v2/public/contacts.

assigned_agent_id.description: Numeric id of the agent the contact is assigned to, as text.

registered_after.description: Only contacts registered after this Unix timestamp, e.g. 1581188318.

registered_before.description: Only contacts registered before this Unix timestamp.

tools.name: boldtrail_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a new contact (lead) in BoldTrail kvCORE. Search first with boldtrail_list_contacts: the API accepts duplicates. Set assigned_agent_id to assign the lead to an agent, and owned_by_assigned to true to keep it private to that agent. Endpoint: POST /v2/public/contact.

assigned_agent_id.description: Numeric id of the agent to assign, as text.

owned_by_assigned.description: True makes the lead private to the assigned agent.
